title: MSA/DPA Quickpass: Evidence Store & Risk Scoring Prototype
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a lightweight 'Quickpass' prototype that maps security questionnaire (SQ) responses to automated contract redline decisions and pricing signals. The scope includes an immutable evidence store for SQ attachments, a risk-scoring model (rules + ML feature) that outputs liability/indemnity recommendation bands, a signal API consumed by Sales preflight UI, and telemetry to measure downstream pricing and legal review deflection.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Evidence store accepts and indexes SQ attachments and links them to customer intake; 2) Risk scorer returns deterministic band (low/medium/high) + recommended indemnity cap and suggested pricing adjustment; 3) Sales preflight UI surfaces Quickpass decision with 'auto-approve' flag for low-risk cases; 4) Telemetry captures time-to-contract, legal-review-rate, and pricing delta; 5) Legal validates the banding rules and signs off on fallback manual review path.
